operations.title: Benincasa identifies the residual four-site grade as Gram-Kummer data
operations.body: Entry 1195 derives the horizontal associated grade. The four cyclic radicands are A11, A11+A22-2A12, A22+A33-2A23, A33 = r_i^T adj(G) r_i for the cycle incidence covectors; each occurs twice, once per Q[C4] orbit. Remaining question is the triangular-gauge-invariant extension with the incident elliptic-pair H1 systems.
